name: Magnetic Levitating Fruit Market
description: A futuristic street market where colorful fruits float in magnetic halos above glowing stalls.
prompt: A single vibrant futuristic market scene: a bustling open-air fruit market where watermelons, oranges, berries, and pineapples levitate in glowing magnetic rings above sleek translucent stalls, soft neon signs with abstract shapes only, friendly shoppers in colorful clothing, solar-punk architecture, warm morning light, playful and clean, high detail, no readable text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Gravity took the day off at the fruit market. 🍉🧲 Which floating snack are you grabbing?
